source.note: Portland Maps Public/Transportation_System_Plan MapServer layer 3 (Transit Classifications), the segments with no transit class read (Transit 'UNK' = Unknown, or blank). The companion of transit-streets.geojson: a lot line beside one of these may be on a transit street, so it is never read as off one (flats/geom/pdx_transit.py). Layer census 2026-11-08 by Transit: LS 30697, TA 3296, MTP 3148, N/A 646, RT 573, RTMTP 400, NULL 183, IPR 58, UNK 27; no CT. TA+MTP+RT+RTMTP = 7417, the count transit-streets.geojson holds (fetched 2026-10-22), so that file is the whole of the layer's transit classes today.
